proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_touching_ground
proposed_widenings.justification: The item activation has a real grounded-use gate that cannot be represented by the existing holding/wearing predicates.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental."

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl.commandRange.unspecified
proposed_widenings.justification: The summon obeys commands, but the text gives no numeric command radius; the current required `commandRangeFeet` field forces invented data.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count."

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl.defaultBehavior.unspecified
proposed_widenings.justification: The control surface currently requires a fallback behavior even when the source text does not define one.

notes: I did not author content files. The item fits the existing magic-item spawned-creature family in broad outline, but current surface fields force fabricated activation/control details.
